name: Darius Jackson
bio:
Darius hails from Atlanta, Georgia, where his love for motorsport was ignited by attending local dirt track races as a child. He initially pursued a culinary degree, but his passion for racing led him to seek opportunities within motorsport. He started as a kitchen assistant at a smaller racing team, quickly demonstrating his organizational skills and ability to manage resources efficiently. Darius's approach to catering management is rooted in understanding the unique dietary needs and preferences of the team, ensuring everyone is well-nourished and performing at their peak. 

What sets Darius apart is his knack for innovation within the catering domain. He's constantly experimenting with new recipes and sourcing local ingredients to create fresh, exciting menus that cater to diverse tastes. His background in culinary arts combined with his organizational talent makes him a valuable asset to any racing team, helping boost morale and overall team performance.

physical.description: Darius is a slender man with a warm smile and an approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down recipe ideas and dietary requests.
Has a habit of humming quietly while preparing meals.
Insists on using fresh, locally sourced ingredients whenever possible, even if it means going to multiple markets.
